column1: # Source: Haverland NA, Skinner OS, Fellers RT, Tariq AA, Early BP, LeDuc RD, Fornelli L,
#   Compton PD, Kelleher NL. "Defining Gas-Phase Fragmentation Propensities of Intact
#   Proteins During Native Top-Down Mass Spectrometry." J Am Soc Mass Spectrom (2017).
# The source sheet is long-format: one row per ordered amino-acid pair (20 x 20 = 400 rows,
#   complete, no duplicates), 15 columns. Extracted here is a single propensity column:
#   It is already (matched fragmentation events / possible fragmentation events), i.e. a
#   dimensionless fraction in [0, 1]. NO rescaling or normalization was applied during
#   extraction - the numbers below are the sheet values verbatim (round-trip G17 formatting).
# The sheet also carries a native top-down column, "Propensity (nTD)". It is deliberately not
#   carried here: 83 of its 400 pairs are exactly zero and C|W was never sampled, so cascades
#   over some sequences stall. Only denatured top-down is modelled.
# Column meaning: the bond considered is NTerminalResidue-CTerminalResidue, i.e. the peptide
#   bond whose N-terminal side carries NTerminalResidue and whose C-terminal side carries
#   CTerminalResidue. In the source sheet these are "N-terminal to fragmentation" and
#   "C-terminal to fragmentation" (source "Residue Pair" column renders this as e.g. C|W).
# Lines starting with '#' are comments and are skipped by the loader.
